paragraphs: ClearGov sells cloud-based software that local governments and school districts use to manage the finance cycle, and it counts more than 2,000 of them as users. Published documents are a large part of the job, with budget books, ACFRs, PAFRs, annual reports, and CIP books built from guided templates.

Department heads submit capital requests through web-based forms that collect consistent data and feed a central dashboard. Finance staff can build and compare different budget scenarios before settling on a plan. Approved work can be published to automatically updated Public Project Pages carrying timelines, financials, maps, photos, and announcements. A strategic plan can likewise be turned into a website so constituents can follow progress over time. Outputs are generated ADA-compliant for sharing, publishing, or print-ready PDF distribution.

The company reports $540B in managed budgets. It also cites a 98% customer satisfaction figure. Its customer success team includes former local government finance officers. For counties, a built-in checklist maps to the criteria for the NACo EDGE Excellence in Strategic Planning Award.

quote.text: 2,000+ local governments and school districts use ClearGov’s cloud-based software to manage the finance cycle.
